image_description: Three disposable lighters arranged side-by-side on a pink surface. The central lighter is encased in clear plastic packaging and features a red base with a black-and-white checkered pattern body that appears to have a glowing blue neon effect. To the left is a red lighter with a cartoon character design (partially visible). To the right is a cream-colored lighter with red accents and a 'ZIPPO' style logo, also partially visible.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The black-and-white checkered pattern on the central lighter has an unnatural 'glowing' blue cyan fringe/halo around the checks. This looks like a diffusion artifact or an overly aggressive neon effect rather than physical print ink.
The cartoon face on the left lighter is distorted. The eyes and mouth lack coherent geometry, appearing melted or smudged, which is common in AI-generated text/graphics on small objects.
The text on the right lighter attempts to mimic a brand logo (possibly Zippo or Bic) but the letters are nonsensical and malformed, lacking sharp edges.
The reflection and refraction of the plastic blister pack are slightly inconsistent. The highlight on the top curve doesn't fully align with the lighting direction implied by the shadows.
